name: Perseus Proteomics Inc.
summary: Perseus Proteomics Inc., based in Tokyo, Japan, is a biotechnology venture developing antibody-based therapeutics for conditions including cancer. It conducts antibody discovery and offers research support such as hybridoma antibody sequencing, antibody protein production and contract antibody research. Its pipeline includes PPMX-T004, an antibody-drug conjugate, and a candidate for adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. Dating from 2001.
